WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
